title: Visuals Mod Pack
description: mods for Hardcore minecraft and streaming
body:
**Vanilla+ Visual & Performance Pack**

A lightweight Fabric modpack focused on improving Minecraft's visuals, performance, and quality of life while preserving the vanilla gameplay experience. Built around modern optimization mods and shader support, this pack delivers smoother gameplay, immersive graphics, and useful utilities without adding new content or changing game progression.
**Features**

- High-performance rendering with **Sodium** and **Entity Culling**
- Full shader support through **Iris**
- Includes **Complementary Unbound**, **Bliss**, and **Mellow** shaders
- Dynamic lighting with **LambDynamicLights**
- Improved player animations with **Not Enough Animations**
- Connected textures via **Continuity**
- Enhanced ore and enchantment visibility
- Smooth zoom with **Zoomify**
- **Xaero's Minimap** and **World Map** included
- Preview Shulker Box contents without opening them
- Easy configuration through **Mod Menu**, **Cloth Config**, and **YACL**
- Keeps the game feeling completely vanilla


![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/680fc8e3ede85ea35b2e6ec04f6de7e1d0e50f7e.png)

**Included Mods**

Performance
- Sodium
- Entity Culling

Graphics
- Iris Shaders
- Continuity
- LambDynamicLights
- Punchy!
- Not Enough Animations
- Outlined Ores
- Enchantment Outline
- Enchantment Outlines

Quality of Life
- Xaero's Minimap
- Xaero's World Map
- Zoomify
- Shulker Box Tooltip

Libraries
- Fabric API
- Fabric Language Kotlin
- Cloth Config API
- Mod Menu
- YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL)
- Melody
- Text Placeholder API

Included Shader Packs

- Complementary Unbound
- Bliss Shaders
- Mellow Shaders

**Loader:** Fabric  
**Focus:** Performance • Visuals • Quality of Life • Vanilla+
